description: Framework-independent Internet reachability monitoring for Dart and Flutter. Confirms real Internet access (not just Wi-Fi) with serialized HTTP checks, periodic recovery, and a transition stream that reports online/offline/unknown states.
rules: InternetStatus starts as unknown until the first check completes; read monitor.status for the current state.
Subscribe to monitor.changes before calling start(); changes is a broadcast stream that emits only transitions (no duplicates, no replay of the current state).
Call start() to begin periodic checks, or call check() alone as a one-shot check or for a 'Retry' button.
Always call dispose() when finished; after dispose, start() and check() throw a StateError.
By default two consecutive failures (failureThreshold = 2) are required before confirming offline; a single failure is not enough.
A custom probe owns its own resources, must finish within checkTimeout, and its exceptions count as failed checks.
networkChanges feeds interface events (e.g. connectivity changes); interface availability alone never proves Internet access.
The built-in HTTP probe requires an exact 204 response from a Google or Cloudflare endpoint; captive-portal redirects or login pages do not satisfy it.
The library has no Flutter dependency and ships no widgets; it works in both Dart and Flutter apps.
